official_form_inventory_corroboration.identity_boundary: This source corroborates collection architecture and form roles. It does not prove that every historical form code is currently active or bind a form listing to respondent microdata.

interpretation.what_discovery_proves: JP currently exposes industry-specific collection instruments across a broad industry universe, independently corroborated by an official statistics form inventory.
interpretation.what_discovery_does_not_prove: A blank form, historical form inventory, or listing does not establish respondent microdata, a published FY2025 direct-investment-profit sector allocation, ownership geography, or company-level dollar amounts.
